name: AP-238
summary: AP-238 is an opioid designer drug related to drugs such as azaprocin and bucinnazine, with around the same potency as morphine. It was first discovered in Italy in the 1960s but was never marketed, subsequently appearing on the illicit market around 2020 and being detected in both Slovenia and the USA.

uses.text: AP-238 is an opioid designer drug related to drugs such as azaprocin and bucinnazine, with around the same potency as morphine. It was first discovered in Italy in the 1960s but was never marketed, subsequently appearing on the illicit market around 2020 and being detected in both Slovenia and the USA.

pharmacology.en: It acts on the mu-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals in the spinal cord and brain, and also slows the brainstem centres that control breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 它作用於 μ 鴉片受體，與嗎啡的標的相同。活化該受體會抑制脊髓與大腦中的疼痛訊號，同時也減緩控制呼吸的腦幹中樞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它作用于 μ 鸦片受体，与吗啡的标的相同。活化该受体会抑制脊髓与大脑中的疼痛信号，同时也减缓控制呼吸的脑干中枢。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Strong opioids cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and can cause fatal overdose and dependence. It has been detected in deaths involving novel opioids.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。強效鴉片類會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，並可能導致致命過量與成癮。它曾在涉及新型鴉片類藥物的死亡案例中被檢出。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。强效鸦片类会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，并可能导致致命过量与成瘾。它曾在涉及新型鸦片类药物的死亡案例中被检出。

fact.en: It was discovered in Italy in the 1960s and then forgotten for half a century, before appearing on the designer drug market in 2019.
fact.zh: AP-238 於 1960 年代在義大利被發現，隨後被遺忘了半個世紀，到 2019 年才出現在設計師藥物市場上。
fact.zhHans: AP-238 于 1960 年代在意大利被发现，随后被遗忘了半个世纪，到 2019 年才出现在设计师药物市场上。
